info.title: eCAF API: VET Student Loans version 20
info.description: Application programming interface for the Department of Employment and Workplace Relations's Electronic Commonwealth Assistance Form (eCAF) application. This schema describes the API for VET Student Loans 1302D-2026 version 20 (effective from 01 January 2026).

BasicAuthentication.description: All API requests must be made using HTTP Basic Auth over HTTPS. Your provider service account and password must be provided as auth credentials.

get.description: Returns a list of enrolments. Not all enrolment information is included - use the single enrolment endpoint to get all the information regarding an enrolment.

parameters.name: SearchType
parameters.description: Search Type (Outstanding, Completed or All)

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Status (EnrolmentDataSubmitted, InvitationSent, Locked, StudentDraft, Expired, StudentSubmitted or Deleted, multiples permitted)

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Id

parameters.name: EcafType
parameters.description: Type of eCAF (VetStudentLoans, VetStudentLoansPaper, HecsHelp, FeeHelp, NuFeeHelp, OuaFeeHelp, FfurCsp, SaHelp, StartupHelp or OsHelp, multiples permitted)

parameters.name: Year
parameters.description: Year (multiples permitted)

parameters.name: CensusFromDate
parameters.description: Earliest census date to be included

parameters.name: CensusToDate
parameters.description: Lastest census date to be included; if no time component is specified, the date will be inclusive

parameters.name: CreatedFromDate
parameters.description: Earliest creation date to be included
